project.name: Cubeage Solar2D IronSource Plugin
project.summary: Self-hosted Solar2D native plugin for IronSource and Unity LevelPlay, owning Android and iOS plugin source plus GitHub Release package artifacts consumed by games.
goals: Maintain the Solar2D plugin.ironSource native integration for Android and iOS.
Package Android and iOS release artifacts that Solar2D apps can consume from GitHub Releases.
Keep IronSource SDK versioning, Solar2D metadata, and platform requirements explicit.
nonGoals: Do not own game-specific ad placement policy, monetization strategy, or app runtime behavior.
Do not own the upstream IronSource SDK or Solar2D runtime.
Do not own central CI runner, enterprise release bot, or platform preview behavior.

owns.name: solar2d-ironsource-lua-api
owns.description: The plugin.ironSource Lua-facing API and event contract documented for Solar2D apps.

owns.name: solar2d-ironsource-native-code
owns.description: Android and iOS native plugin source that bridges Solar2D to IronSource or Unity LevelPlay SDK behavior.

owns.name: solar2d-ironsource-release-artifacts
owns.description: GitHub Release package artifacts android.tgz and iphone.tgz consumed by Solar2D build settings.

doesNotOwn: Game-specific ad placement, monetization policy, analytics interpretation, or app runtime behavior.
Upstream IronSource SDK releases, Solar2D runtime behavior, or app-store submission policy.
Central Sylphx preview platform, central CI runner capacity, branch protection policy, or enterprise release bot behavior.

allowedDependencies.surface: published plugin package consumed from GitHub Releases
Solar2D SDK release assets and runtime headers

forbiddenCouplings: Do not add game-specific ad placement policy or monetization behavior to the reusable plugin.
Do not consume private app internals from plugin code.
Do not treat source revert as sufficient recovery after release artifacts have been published.
Do not encode central release-bot, runner-capacity, secret-management, or branch-protection policy as plugin behavior.

delivery.deployPath: Release artifacts are built by .github/workflows/build-android.yml and .github/workflows/build-ios.yml, then published by .github/workflows/release.yml on v* tag pushes. No required PR status context is currently configured in branch protection.
delivery.productionProof: Release changes require Android and iOS build artifacts, package smoke evidence, GitHub Release asset readback, and consumer compatibility notes for affected apps. Manifest-only changes are proven by the doctrine project-control audit.

packageRelease.releaseIntent: Current state is a v* tag-triggered release workflow; dedicated release-intent PR is not yet adopted.
packageRelease.versionPr: Not currently implemented; future path should use a bot-owned version or release PR before tag publication.
packageRelease.publisher: .github/workflows/release.yml currently publishes with repository GITHUB_TOKEN; future path should use a dedicated least-privilege release GitHub App or bot.
packageRelease.publishProof: GitHub Release readback for android.tgz and iphone.tgz plus package smoke evidence.

gaps.description: Branch protection has no required PR status contexts for plugin or package changes.
Package release is tag-triggered and currently uses GITHUB_TOKEN instead of a dedicated release GitHub App or bot-owned version PR.
Repository has not adopted central ADR-29 stable admission fan-in contexts.
gaps.target: Central CI runner and admission control plane
